messages:
Oliver: FYI customer ACME-Intl opened a support case — invoices not matching PO totals across entities. They say EUR invoice shows €0.10 difference after FX rounding when consolidating to GBP.
Anna (Support): They attached screenshots, invoice IDs INV-2026-834 (EUR, entity FR) and INV-2026-835 (JPY, entity JP). PO 2026-PO-900 maps to the US entity in our system. :confused: 
Maria (Billing): Hmm, sounds like our PO->entity mapping logic is falling back to billing_account_id instead of legal_entity_id. I can repro locally.
Oliver: Repro steps I used:
```
SELECT id, currency, total_cents, legal_entity_id, po_number
FROM invoices
WHERE po_number = '2026-PO-900';
```
I saw totals: EUR 12400 cents, GBP 11200 cents — FX rounding when converting to GBP on consolidation.
Rahul (Sales): Customer insists on receiving invoices in local currency (GBP) for the UK subsidiary. They won't accept consolidated EUR.
Anna (Support): What are quick mitigation options? They need something this week.
Maria (Billing): Short term: reissue invoices from the UK legal entity with the same line items and include a memo referencing the original INV IDs. Longer term: fix mapping. For the rounding delta, we can add an adjustment line item of -€0.10 or equivalent to reconcile. :white_check_mark: 
PaymentsBot: Auto-detected failed charge: txn_3J4K - card_decline - reason: insufficient_funds on 2026-11-14 08:12:21 UTC. Linked invoice INV-2026-835.
Anna (Support): Card decline complicates it — should we wait for payment or issue credit note now?
Oliver: Issue a provisional credit note from the FR entity for the exact rounding delta, then reissue UK invoice once the customer confirms PO/legal entity. Keep audit trail. Accounting will post a reversing entry.
Maria (Billing): I'll create the credit note draft. For the mapping fix, steps:
```
1) update service: invoice-generator
2) change lookup to legal_entity_id precedence
3) add unit tests for multi-entity PO mapping
4) deploy canary to staging
```
I'll open PR and tag @Rahul for customer confirmation.
Rahul (Sales): Ping me once draft is ready. I'll confirm with customer and get the UK legal entity details.
Anna (Support): I'll reply to the support thread with the workaround (credit note + reissue) and ETA. Also asking finance contact.
Oliver: Filing a finance escalation ticket: FIN-4521 with attachments and SQL export. Assigning to Maria and Oliver. Deadline EOD Friday.
Maria (Billing): On it. I'll also include a snippet of the FX rounding logic we currently use:
```
// naive conversion
converted = Math.round(amount_cents * fx_rate)
```
We need banker's rounding instead.
Rahul (Sales): Thanks team. Keep me looped. :pray:
